This bean plot is small, just 0.24 hectares, so I will be careful with cash and stay close to what has worked for me and other farmers here in Dowa. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot because one bag is too expensive for such a small area, and on beans I usually manage with the soil as it is and with a bit of compost or manure if I have it. I will use improved seed because I have seen other farmers get a better stand with it, but I will not spend money on chemicals unless I see a serious problem. I will rely on the rains, use family labor, and I will not hire people for such a small plot.
